newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends up after light-volume day.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends up after light-volume day.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed with modest gains after session that featured light short covering and commercial buying, traders said.
Traders said it was hard to identify a reason for the gains. A sale of 41,000 tonnes of wheat to the Philippines failed to spark a bullish reaction, because traders said the business was expected.
Pending export tenders to Taiwan and Japan lent light support but these also have been anticipated, they said.

Cargill Investor Services bought about one million bushels of December and Atwood Larson about 700,000. Leading sellers included Wilson Trading with about one million of December and LFG with one million March.
Minneapolis wheat closed up 6-1/2 to four cents a bushel with December up 4-1/4 at $4.22-3/4 per bushel.
